info.name: Outline Debugger
info.description: Visualize the DOM by element type with 1px dotted outlines. A fresh 15-color set, even saturation, walked around the wheel and solved so that any element which nests inside another lands >=48 deg away in hue (ul/li, table/tr/th/td, div/section are far further). div & section are kept pale so the outer box reads as a frame.

style.css:
/* ============================================================
   Outline Debugger — visualize the DOM by element type with
   1px dotted outlines. A fresh 15-color set, even saturation,
   walked around the wheel and solved so that any element which
   nests inside another lands >=48 deg away in hue (ul/li,
   table/tr/th/td, div/section are far further). div & section
   are kept pale so the outer box reads as a frame.
   ============================================================ */

/* --- Inline & links ------------------------------------------------ */
a                       {outline:1px dotted #DCC874!important;}    /* sand       */
span                    {outline:1px dotted #DC7474!important;}    /* coral      */

/* --- Headings ------------------------------------------------------ */
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6  {outline:1px dotted #C874DC!important;}    /* orchid     */

/* --- Text block ---------------------------------------------------- */
p                       {outline:1px dotted #74DC74!important;}    /* green      */

/* --- Media --------------------------------------------------------- */
img, svg,
picture, video, canvas  {outline:1px dotted #74C8DC!important;}    /* sky        */

/* --- Form controls ------------------------------------------------- */
input, textarea,
select, button          {outline:1px dotted #DC749E!important;}    /* rose       */

/* --- Lists --------------------------------------------------------- */
ul, ol, dl              {outline:1px dotted #9E74DC!important;}    /* violet     */
li, dt, dd              {outline:1px dotted #9EDC74!important;}    /* lime       */

/* --- Tables -------------------------------------------------------- */
table                   {outline:1px dotted #74DC9E!important;}    /* mint       */
thead, tbody,
tfoot, tr               {outline:1px dotted #C8DC74!important;}    /* chartreuse */
th                      {outline:1px dotted #7474DC!important;}    /* indigo     */
td                      {outline:1px dotted #DC74C8!important;}    /* magenta    */

/* --- Boxes (pale = frame) ------------------------------------------ */
div                     {outline:1px dotted #9ADACD!important;}    /* pale aqua  */
section, article, main,
header, footer,
nav, aside              {outline:1px dotted #DAB49A!important;}    /* pale clay  */

/* --- Icons & generated content ------------------------------------- */
i,
::before,
::after                 {outline:1px dotted #799BCD!important;}    /* steel      */
